description_en: Creates a predictive dialing campaign under a specified instance
description_zh: 调用CreateCampaign在指定实例下创建预测式外呼活动
kebab_example: aliyun ccc create-campaign --instance-id ccc-test --queue-id skillgroup@ccc-test --name test-campaign --contact-flow-id c1f2bc75-422e-43c7-9c9d9d95633a --start-time 1634140800000 --end-time 1634313600000 --callable-time beginTime_:_00:00:00_,_endTime_:_23:00:00 --strategy-type PACING --strategy-parameters ratio_:1 --max-attempt-count 1 --min-attempt-interval 1 --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateCampaign

fields.help_en: The custom variables of the customer. The value is a JSON object that contains up to 10 properties. The name and value of each property are customized by the customer
fields.help_zh: 客户自定义变量，格式为JSON对象，对象最多包含10个属性，每个属性的名称和值均由客户自定义
fields.name: custom_variables

fields.help_en: The phone number of the contact
fields.name: phone_number

fields.help_en: The business ID, which is an identifier in the customer's business system and is used in integration scenarios
fields.help_zh: 业务ID，客户业务系统标识，用于集成场景
fields.name: reference_id

parameters.help_en: The list of contacts for the predictive dialing campaign. This parameter cannot be used together with CaseFileKey, which is used for importing contacts from a file. You can choose to import contacts either from a file or from a list
parameters.help_zh: 预测式外呼名单列表，不能与CaseFileKey（从文件导入）同时使用，文件导入和列表导入只能选择一种
parameters.name: case_list

parameters.help_en: The ID of the skill group associated with the predictive dialing campaign
parameters.help_zh: 预测式外呼活动关联的技能组ID
parameters.name: queue_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the predictive dialing campaign
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The key of the Object Storage Service (OSS) object that stores the contact file for the predictive dialing campaign. You can obtain the key by calling the GetCaseFileUploadUrl operation
parameters.help_zh: 预测式外呼名单文件，是一个OSS对象的Key，通过GetCaseFileUploadUrl接口获取
parameters.name: case_file_key

parameters.help_en: The ID of the contact flow associated with the predictive dialing campaign
parameters.help_zh: 预测式外呼活动关联的联系流ID
parameters.name: contact_flow_id

parameters.help_en: The start time of the predictive dialing campaign. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 预测式外呼活动开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位毫秒
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the predictive dialing campaign. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 预测式外呼活动结束时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位毫秒
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The callable time period for the predictive dialing campaign. The value is a JSON object that contains two properties: beginTime and endTime. Example: [{"beginTime":"00:00:00","endTime":"23:00:00"}]
parameters.help_zh: 预测式外呼活动的可外呼时段，格式为JSON对象，对象包含两个属性，beginTime和EndTime，例如：[{"beginTime":"00:00:00","endTime":"23:00:00" }]
parameters.name: callable_time

parameters.help_en: The strategy mode of the predictive dialing campaign
parameters.help_zh: 预测式外呼活动的策略模式
parameters.name: strategy_type

parameters.help_en: The strategy parameters of the predictive dialing campaign. Example for the PID strategy: {"abandonRate":"5","historicalConnectedRate":"35"}. Example for the PACING strategy: {"ratio":1}. abandonRate specifies the expected abandonment rate, historicalConnectedRate specifies the historical reference connection rate, and ratio specifies the fixed dialing ratio
parameters.help_zh: 预测式外呼活动的策略参数，PID策略下的格式参数示例：{"abandonRate":"5","historicalConnectedRate":"35"}，PACING策略下的格式参数示例：{"ratio":1}。abandonRate表示期望呼损率，historicalConnectedRate表示历史参考接通率，ratio表示固定外呼比例
parameters.name: strategy_parameters

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of call attempts for the predictive dialing campaign. This parameter specifies the maximum number of times a failed call can be retried
parameters.help_zh: 预测式外呼活动的最大尝试次数，表示当活动的号码呼叫失败时，最多重呼几次
parameters.name: max_attempt_count

parameters.help_en: The minimum retry interval for the predictive dialing campaign. This parameter specifies the minimum interval between retry attempts for failed calls, in minutes
parameters.help_zh: 预测式外呼活动的最小重呼间隔，表示失败重呼时的最小间隔，单位分钟
parameters.name: min_attempt_interval

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the campaign is a simulated campaign for testing purposes. Regular customers do not need to pay attention to this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 是否是模拟活动，用于测试，普通客户无需关心
parameters.name: simulation

parameters.help_en: The simulation parameters for testing purposes. Regular customers do not need to pay attention to this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 模拟参数，用于测试，普通客户无需关心
parameters.name: simulation_parameters

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to keep the campaign in the executing state until it expires. Default value: false. If this parameter is set to false, the campaign automatically changes to the completed state after all contacts are called. If this parameter is set to true, the campaign does not automatically change to the completed state after all contacts are called. Instead, it remains in the executing state, and you can continue to add contacts to the campaign for dialing until the campaign expires or is manually stopped
parameters.help_zh: 是否在活动到期前保持执行状态。默认值fasle，当活动的所有联系人都呼叫完成后，活动会自动变为已完成状态；如果为True，当活动的所有联系人都呼叫完成后，活动不会自动变成已完成状态，仍是执行中状态，可以继续像活动中追加联系人，进而继续进行拨打，直到任务到期或手动终止
parameters.name: executing_until_timeout

parameters.help_en: The ID of the number group
parameters.name: inst_group_id

Data.description_en: The ID of the predictive dialing campaign
